name: Baldur's Gate 3
notes: Since Patch 8 the Vulkan renderer crashes on many Proton systems — the game now runs best on its DX11 path (via DXVK). If the game crashes before the menu, pick 'Baldur's Gate 3 (DirectX 11)' in Steam's play dialog. force_vulkan remains available but is no longer recommended on Proton. The Larian launcher is bypassed with --skip-launcher. NVIDIA: NVAPI enables DLSS. AMD: RADV ICD ensures the Mesa Vulkan driver is used.
